script: sitting in my car after work one evening, engine still running

props.description: Dark cinematic close-up of a car interior at night — warm amber dashboard glow, rain blurring the windshield, hands resting on the steering wheel. Text fades in word by word: 'I couldn't make myself go upstairs yet.' The frame holds completely still. A slow, barely-audible heartbeat pulse on the audio layer, like the engine idling in the dark — weight without motion.
